protocol.world: Procedural 13 by 13 road nodes over 10 km; seeded deadlines/priorities, finite protected stock and fleets. Evaluator adds the same recorded demands/resources to every arm before initial HTTP observations.
protocol.operator: Scripted finite owner review, not human UX
protocol.clock: declared modeled tool/review/model/physical delays, not x1 inference latency
protocol.interpretation: Hundred concurrent needs compete physically. The number of inputs is not the number served; backlog, pending stock, losses and failures remain visible. Semantic quality is evaluated separately.
protocol.sourceScope: Received official observations plus 10 social-format publications per added need, with public repost lineage. No truth labels, future events or evaluator stock objects are sent to the candidate.

limitations: Internal synthetic physical competition, not independently authored disaster calibration
Added demand, stock and publications are identical by seed for every arm and received through the same HTTP/consent paths
The number of available or acknowledged sources is not semantic accuracy
Completed native-unit service, attention limits and pending unmet needs are reported separately; no lives-saved claim
